---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or a new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

**What problem are you trying to solve?**
<!-- Describe the workflow gap, the friction, or the missing capability. Concrete examples beat abstract framing. -->

**What would the ideal solution look like?**
<!-- What does success look like from your perspective? UI sketches, sample CSV/PDF outputs, or a description of the new behavior all help. -->

**Have you considered alternatives?**
<!-- Existing tools, workarounds you currently use, or partial solutions you'd accept. -->

**How does this fit your work?**
<!-- Solo developer? Agency? Internal team? Roughly how often does the missing feature bite you? -->

**Additional context**
<!-- Screenshots, related roadmap items (https://reflog.run/roadmap), references to similar features in other tools. -->

---

Roadmap items are tracked at <https://reflog.run/roadmap>. If your request
overlaps with something already there, linking helps prioritization.
